description: Create a new survey in LimeSurvey titled '2026 Doctoral Research Fellowship'. Configure the survey to allow participants to save and resume later (General Settings > Participant settings > 'Participant may save and resume later': On). Add a question group 'Application Materials' and a 'File upload' question titled 'Research Proposal' (code: 'proposal'). Configure the file upload attributes to ONLY allow 'pdf' files, set the maximum file size to 5120 KB (5 MB), and allow a maximum of 3 files. Finally, customize the 'Saved' email template subject (Email templates > Saved) to read exactly: 'Fellowship Application Progress Saved - Do Not Delete'.

metadata.expected_email_subject: Fellowship Application Progress Saved - Do Not Delete
